died.name: Bena Tshadi soccer team
died.cause: All 11 members of the Bena Tshadi soccer team located in Kasaï-Central, were struck by lightning and killed during a match against a team from Basanga. 30 others, including spectators and members of the Bena Tshadi team on the sidelines, were injured. No members of the Basanga soccer team were injured. No official cause has been reported; however, The Guardian reported that researchers suggest that it was because the Bena Tshadi team used screwed-in metal cleats that conducted electricity whereas the Basanga team used moulded cleats.
